headline: Stlican Shelf Revives; Godcrofts, Stonecradle Flare
war_summary: Since the last edition, the battle line has shifted again. Weathered Expanse, which led the previous flurry, has gone quiet: no strategic-base event has been recorded there since 15:15, though the day's count stands at twenty-two. Godcrofts has reawakened with four events in the latest two-hour window, six in six hours and nine in twenty-four, the most recent at Argosa and Lipsia shortly before the dispatch. Stonecradle remains in full cry, posting four events in two hours, eleven in six and eighteen on the day, with casualties mounting on both sides. Stlican Shelf, after a lull, has stirred again with two events in the latest two hours; its twenty-four-hour tally of thirty-nine remains the busiest front, centered on The Pale House. DeadLands has not moved since 13:31 but still shows eighteen events on the day. Callahan's Passage has seen no new strategic-base event since The Latch near eight o'clock, although fighting there stays heavy. No victory has been declared.
